name: My New Neighbors
source:
One day a normal town's routine is shattered when a family of nudists moves next door to our main characters. Who are these strange people and how will they change his world forever. 

[From [url=https://rmaximus.itch.io/my-new-neighbors]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，当一个裸体主义者家庭搬到我们主角的隔壁时，一个正常城镇的日常生活被打破了。这些奇怪的人是谁，他们将如何永远改变他的世界。

[来自[url=https://rmaximus.itch.io/my-new-neighbors]Itch.io[/url]]
